lessons.title: Identify plumbing components
materials: An instructor-supplied parts diagram or disconnected training components

steps.title: Inventory the training kit
steps.instructions: Use only the supplied diagram or disconnected classroom components. Record each component label and the matching reference in your instructor worksheet.
steps.expected_visual_result: A labelled inventory sheet is visible.
assessment_criteria: Every listed component name matches a reference in the worksheet — no unmatched entries.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Use only the supplied diagram or disconnected classroom components. Record each component label and the matching reference in your instructor worksheet.

steps.title: Annotate the layout
steps.instructions: On a copy of the instructor-supplied diagram, mark the component labels and questions you need the instructor to answer. Do not operate valves or connect the kit to a water supply.
steps.expected_visual_result: The diagram contains readable labels and questions.
assessment_criteria: Each label sits next to the component it names, and open questions are listed separately from labels.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: On a copy of the instructor-supplied diagram, mark the component labels and questions you need the instructor to answer. Do not operate valves or connect the kit to a water supply.

steps.title: Prepare a handover
steps.instructions: Photograph your worksheet and write a short handover describing what you identified and what you could not verify.
steps.expected_visual_result: A completed worksheet and handover are visible.
assessment_criteria: The handover states which components were identified and which could not be verified — nothing is left unstated.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Photograph your worksheet and write a short handover describing what you identified and what you could not verify.

lessons.safety_notice: Classroom and disconnected training only. Instructor approval is separate from AI feedback and is not a licence or safety certification.
practice_restrictions: Do not use these starter tasks for live installations or unsupervised trade work.

lessons.title: Plan a supervised plumbing practice
materials: An instructor-supplied job brief, blank paper and pencil

steps.title: Read the brief
steps.instructions: Read the classroom job brief. List its intended result, supplied materials and information that is missing.
steps.expected_visual_result: The planning sheet lists the result, materials and open questions.
assessment_criteria: All three sections (result, materials, questions) are present, and the result is written in one sentence.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Read the classroom job brief. List its intended result, supplied materials and information that is missing.

steps.title: Prepare questions
steps.instructions: Write questions about the approved training setup, supervision and checks your instructor will demonstrate. Do not begin work on an installed system.
steps.expected_visual_result: A list of instructor questions is visible.
assessment_criteria: Every question refers to a named step or component — no general questions.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Write questions about the approved training setup, supervision and checks your instructor will demonstrate. Do not begin work on an installed system.

steps.title: Request review
steps.instructions: Arrange your planning sheet and notes for instructor review. Record that no installed plumbing was worked on.
steps.expected_visual_result: The review packet is complete and labelled training only.
assessment_criteria: The packet states, in your own words, that no installed plumbing was worked on.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Arrange your planning sheet and notes for instructor review. Record that no installed plumbing was worked on.

lessons.title: Read an instructor-supplied circuit diagram
materials: A printed classroom diagram, pencil and instructor symbol key

steps.title: Label the worksheet
steps.instructions: Use the instructor symbol key to annotate the printed diagram. Record uncertainties rather than guessing. Do not open equipment or connect anything to power.
steps.expected_visual_result: A diagram annotated using the supplied key is visible.
assessment_criteria: Uncertainties are recorded as questions, not filled in as guesses.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Use the instructor symbol key to annotate the printed diagram. Record uncertainties rather than guessing. Do not open equipment or connect anything to power.

steps.title: Trace on paper
steps.instructions: Mark the connections on a second paper copy and compare your annotations with the instructor reference. This is a paper task only.
steps.expected_visual_result: The paper diagram shows your trace and reference labels.
assessment_criteria: Your traced connections match the instructor reference; any mismatch is circled and noted.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Mark the connections on a second paper copy and compare your annotations with the instructor reference. This is a paper task only.

steps.title: Prepare a review note
steps.instructions: List the differences and questions for your instructor. A photograph can show your worksheet, not electrical safety or competence.
steps.expected_visual_result: A review note with questions is visible.
assessment_criteria: Each difference from the reference appears with its own question.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: List the differences and questions for your instructor. A photograph can show your worksheet, not electrical safety or competence.

lessons.title: Prepare for supervised electrical training
materials: An instructor-issued training brief and a blank worksheet

steps.title: Read the scope
steps.instructions: Write down the classroom exercise scope and identify the named supervisor from the supplied brief. If no supervisor is named, record that as a blocker.
steps.expected_visual_result: A scope and supervision note is visible.
assessment_criteria: The named supervisor is written on the note, or no supervisor named is recorded as a blocker.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Write down the classroom exercise scope and identify the named supervisor from the supplied brief. If no supervisor is named, record that as a blocker.

steps.title: Record prerequisites
steps.instructions: Copy the prerequisites from the instructor brief and mark each as confirmed or unconfirmed. Do not perform isolation, testing or installation based on app instructions.
steps.expected_visual_result: A prerequisite checklist is visible.
assessment_criteria: Every prerequisite line is marked confirmed or unconfirmed — none left blank.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Copy the prerequisites from the instructor brief and mark each as confirmed or unconfirmed. Do not perform isolation, testing or installation based on app instructions.

steps.title: Prepare for instructor approval
steps.instructions: Write a handover of the unresolved prerequisites. Ask your instructor to review it before any practical work.
steps.expected_visual_result: A handover lists unresolved prerequisites.
assessment_criteria: The handover asks for the instructor review before any practical work.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Write a handover of the unresolved prerequisites. Ask your instructor to review it before any practical work.

lessons.title: Read a dimensioned practice drawing
materials: An instructor drawing, ruler, paper and pencil

steps.title: Read the drawing
steps.instructions: Copy the dimensions and units shown on the instructor practice drawing into a worksheet. Mark unclear dimensions.
steps.expected_visual_result: The copied dimensions and units are legible.
assessment_criteria: Units are written next to every number, and unclear dimensions are flagged.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Copy the dimensions and units shown on the instructor practice drawing into a worksheet. Mark unclear dimensions.

steps.title: Mark a paper template
steps.instructions: Use a ruler to mark a paper template from the supplied dimensions. Keep this exercise on paper; no cutting or powered tools.
steps.expected_visual_result: A paper template with labelled dimensions is visible.
assessment_criteria: Marked lengths match the drawn dimensions when checked against the ruler.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Use a ruler to mark a paper template from the supplied dimensions. Keep this exercise on paper; no cutting or powered tools.

steps.title: Compare with the reference
steps.instructions: Compare the template with the instructor reference and record differences for review.
steps.expected_visual_result: A comparison note is visible.
assessment_criteria: Each difference between template and reference is recorded with its measurement.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Compare the template with the instructor reference and record differences for review.

lessons.title: Prepare a materials worksheet
materials: An instructor project brief and blank paper

steps.title: List components
steps.instructions: List the components specified by the instructor project brief without substituting specifications.
steps.expected_visual_result: A component list is visible.
assessment_criteria: Every listed component carries the specification given in the brief — no substitutions.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: List the components specified by the instructor project brief without substituting specifications.

steps.title: Draft a materials list
steps.instructions: Record the quantities and units in a simple table. Flag missing values for your instructor.
steps.expected_visual_result: A quantities table is visible.
assessment_criteria: Each row shows a quantity with its unit, and missing values are flagged.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Record the quantities and units in a simple table. Flag missing values for your instructor.

steps.title: Prepare the review packet
steps.instructions: Put the brief, drawing and materials table together with your unresolved questions.
steps.expected_visual_result: A labelled review packet is visible.
assessment_criteria: The packet contains all three items (brief, drawing, table) plus the open questions.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Put the brief, drawing and materials table together with your unresolved questions.

lessons.title: Document a mock inspection
materials: Instructor-supplied equipment photos and an inspection worksheet

steps.title: Identify the reference
steps.instructions: Record the equipment identifier supplied in the classroom photo pack. Do not inspect live or moving equipment.
steps.expected_visual_result: A worksheet with the supplied identifier is visible.
assessment_criteria: The identifier is copied exactly, letter for letter.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Record the equipment identifier supplied in the classroom photo pack. Do not inspect live or moving equipment.

steps.title: Record visible observations
steps.instructions: Describe only what is visible in the supplied photos. Separate observations from guesses and mark anything needing an instructor check.
steps.expected_visual_result: An observation table separates visible details and unknowns.
assessment_criteria: No guess appears in the observations column; every unknown has an instructor-check marker.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Describe only what is visible in the supplied photos. Separate observations from guesses and mark anything needing an instructor check.

steps.title: Write a handover
steps.instructions: Write a short handover from your worksheet without claiming that the equipment is safe to use.
steps.expected_visual_result: The handover includes unresolved checks.
assessment_criteria: The handover makes no claim that the equipment is safe to use.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Write a short handover from your worksheet without claiming that the equipment is safe to use.

lessons.title: Create a practice job card
materials: An instructor mock work request and blank job card

steps.title: Summarize the request
steps.instructions: Copy the mock request identifier, reported issue and scope into the job card.
steps.expected_visual_result: The job card identifies the request and scope.
assessment_criteria: The scope line separates what was requested from what was done.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Copy the mock request identifier, reported issue and scope into the job card.

steps.title: Record evidence
steps.instructions: List the supplied evidence and missing information. Do not invent completed work or measurements.
steps.expected_visual_result: Evidence and missing information are listed.
assessment_criteria: Every missing item has a question or a named source to obtain it.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: List the supplied evidence and missing information. Do not invent completed work or measurements.

steps.title: Request review
steps.instructions: Write the proposed next questions and submit the job card for instructor review.
steps.expected_visual_result: The job card is labelled for instructor review.
assessment_criteria: The proposed next questions are written before submission.
visual_limits: Photos cannot verify measurements, hidden properties, safe isolation or occupational competence.

source_reference.quote: Write the proposed next questions and submit the job card for instructor review.
